text.EN: I can't fetch that right now.
That's in a death trap. I'm not fetching it.
text.TL: Nasa bitag ng kamatayan 'yan. Di ko kukunin.

text.EN: Too far or too dangerous. Refusing to fetch.
text.TL: Masyadong malayo o mapanganib. Tumatangging kunin.

text.EN: My hands and pack are completely full.
text.TL: Puno na ang kamay at bag ko.

text.EN: I won't risk my neck for that junk.
text.TL: Di ko isusugal ang buhay ko para sa basurang 'yan.

text.EN: Can't retrieve that under current conditions.
I don't have the carrying capacity right now.
text.TL: Wala na akong espasyong paglalagyan ngayon.

text.EN: Fetch order rejected. Pick it up yourself.
text.TL: Tinatanggihan ang pagkuha. Pulutin mo nang kusa.

text.EN: Unable to comply. Item is out of bounds.
text.TL: Di makasusunod. Di abot ang bagay na 'yan.

text.EN: I can't fetch that for you.
